g.text: Power: SW1 common = the 3.3 V rail. SAO = badge 3.3 V feeds the rail (and the XIAO through its 3V3 pin). OFF ties D1 to the rail through R13. USB-BAT leaves the badge disconnected; the XIAO runs from USB-C or the LiPo on J5.

g.desc: Power: SW1 common = the 3.3 V rail. SAO = badge 3.3 V feeds the rail (and the XIAO through its 3V3 pin). OFF ties D1 to the rail through R13. USB-BAT leaves the badge disconnected; the XIAO runs from USB-C or the LiPo on J5.

g.text: Badge I2C (SDA/SCL, J1 and Qwiic J3): XIAO D4/D5 as an I2C target. No pull-ups on this board (the badge has them); the maker's R7/R8 4k7 are gone.

g.desc: Badge I2C (SDA/SCL, J1 and Qwiic J3): XIAO D4/D5 as an I2C target. No pull-ups on this board (the badge has them); the maker's R7/R8 4k7 are gone.

g.text: Private I2C (PRIV_SDA/PRIV_SCL, Qwiic J4): XIAO D0/D8 as controller (bit-banged), touch chip U3 at 0x28, pull-ups R11/R12 1.3k. They also hold the C3's start-up pins GPIO2/GPIO8 high.

g.desc: Private I2C (PRIV_SDA/PRIV_SCL, Qwiic J4): XIAO D0/D8 as controller (bit-banged), touch chip U3 at 0x28, pull-ups R11/R12 1.3k. They also hold the C3's start-up pins GPIO2/GPIO8 high.

g.text: Display: CS tied to ground (only device on its wires); RST from R16/C1 at power-up (no pin left); backlight always on through R9 11 ohm as the maker had it.

g.desc: Display: CS tied to ground (only device on its wires); RST from R16/C1 at power-up (no pin left); backlight always on through R9 11 ohm as the maker had it.

g.text: Speaker on J2: D10 -> R14||R15 (165 ohm, limits current to about 19 mA) -> J2 pin 2; D2 -> JP1 -> J2 pin 1. JP1 1-2 bridged = push-pull (maker's default). Cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 for one-sided drive.

g.desc: Speaker on J2: D10 -> R14||R15 (165 ohm, limits current to about 19 mA) -> J2 pin 2; D2 -> JP1 -> J2 pin 1. JP1 1-2 bridged = push-pull (maker's default). Cut 1-2 and bridge 2-3 for one-sided drive.

g.text: Do not plug in USB with the switch on SAO while on a badge: two 3.3 V regulators would share one rail.

g.desc: Do not plug in USB with the switch on SAO while on a badge: two 3.3 V regulators would share one rail.

g.text: Cue light D1 (front): 3.3 V -> R10 1.3k -> D1 -> D9 (pulled low to light). D9 is the C3's BOOT pin; pressing BOOT also lights it.

g.desc: Cue light D1 (front): 3.3 V -> R10 1.3k -> D1 -> D9 (pulled low to light). D9 is the C3's BOOT pin; pressing BOOT also lights it.
